block.title: In-game enemy sprite sheet: skeet, vane, tender
block.positive: Pixel art sprite sheet, SNES 16-bit arcade game style, flat solid deep-navy sheet background, generous even margins between sprites, absolutely no text, numbers or labels. Three enemy types of a planetary-orbit swarm, all facing left in side view: 1) SKEET — an egg-shaped armored drone pod, gunmetal plate shell, rust-violet joints, glowing pink eye-slit, shown in idle, hatch-open firing, and destroyed-fragments frames; 2) VANE — a small steel core ringed by three spinning crescent blades with polished lilac edges, shown at four rotational phases so the blades form a blur-star silhouette; 3) TENDER — a wide, low carrier with a clipped delta silhouette, rows of tiny green lights, an open ventral bay where mini skeet pods are queued nose-down, in closed-bay and open-bay frames. Bold dark outlines around every sprite, saturated limited palette, chunky readable forms that stay clear at small size, classic cartridge-era crispness with light dithering on metal.

block.notes: Landscape strip: one species per third of the canvas, easiest layout for extraction. flux.1-dev is the steadiest at "absolutely no text" sheets. Color reference: shell gunmetal, seams rust-violet, lights #40d070, eye #ff5aa0.
